methodologyNotes: Covers full-length adult Olympic barbells (nominally 2200 mm long with 50 mm sleeves) sold at a published US price for strength training: multipurpose, Olympic weightlifting, and powerlifting bars. Excludes women's 15 kg / 25 mm bars, technique/training bars under 15 kg, specialty bars (trap/hex, safety-squat, curl, Swiss, axle, deadlift-specific), and fixed-weight barbells. Price is typical US retail (MSRP) in USD. barWeightKg is bar mass in kilograms (men's Olympic bars are 20 kg, roughly 44 lb). shaftDiameterMm is grip/shaft diameter in millimeters (28 mm Olympic, 28.5 mm hybrid, 29 mm powerlifting). lengthMm is total bar length in millimeters. loadableSleeveLengthMm is usable sleeve loading length per side in millimeters. tensileStrengthPsi is shaft steel tensile strength in PSI; null if not disclosed. weightCapacityLb is the manufacturer's rated static load in pounds; null if not disclosed. sleeveBearing is the sleeve rotation system, an enum of bronze-bushing, composite-bushing, needle-bearing, or hybrid. knurlPattern is the knurl-mark ring standard, an enum of olympic (IWF dual marks), powerlifting (IPF dual marks), dual (both ring positions), or single (one center ring). centerKnurl is a boolean for whether a center knurl is present. shaftFinish is the shaft coating, an enum of bare-steel, black-zinc, bright-zinc, chrome, hard-chrome, cerakote, stainless-steel, e-coat, or duracoat. sleeveFinish is the sleeve coating using the same value set as shaftFinish.
